Implementation notes

These are original studies, not redistributed Osmo recipes. GSAP is pinned to 3.13.0, Lenis to 1.3.11. On narrow viewports or reduced motion, pinning and scrubbed travel become normal flow. Enable smoothing only when it supports the experience. Animation setup cleans up through gsap.matchMedia; controls can rebuild it.
